topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery of viral and cellular transforming genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the investigation of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classifications and functional mechanisms of cancer genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the concepts, definitions, and allelic mechanisms that distinguish oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes in cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms of sequence and chromosomal genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA replication, repair pathways, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce genomic instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the sequential accumulation of somatic mutations and inherited germline defects drive cancer progression and evolution.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture and provides reading recommendations.
